newsitem.title: CHINA: China Overseas in US$50 mln bridges deal.
newsitem.headline: China Overseas in US$50 mln bridges deal.

text.p: China Overseas Land & Investment Ltd said it signed an agreement on Sunday to acquire 85 percent of the operation rights of six toll bridges and a road in southwestern China's Liuzhou for US$50 million.
The firm will take an 85 percent stake in a joint venture to be formed with a local authority and the new firm will operate the bridges and the road, China Overseas said in a statement.
The total investment of the project is US$59 million, of which China Overseas will invest US$50 million, or 85 percent.
The Chinese partner, Liuzhou Economic Development Corp, will contribute the remaining US$9 million by means of granting the joint venture operating rights for the bridges and road for 15 years.
The project is guaranteed an internal rate of return of 15 percent, the statement said.
Four of the six bridges are already in operation while the other two are under construction and expected to be in full operation by early and the end of 1998 respectively.
The company has invested a total US$125 million in Nanning and Liuzhou in southwestern China's Guangxi region, the statement said.
